name: Camper daylight surplus battery charge UI capture
preconditions: Deferred, not run. Requires later approval for live game control. Use a disposable save with camper body, enabled solar bank with cells, enabled battery bank with a partly discharged original car battery, full sunlight, daytime and zero external demand. Open camper Energy Management through its actual radial action and select the battery-bank card so component charge bars are visible. Compare both screenshots and UI trees for rising battery charge; screenshot creation alone does not prove success. Repeat manually at night/shade/off bank (no charge), under fully consuming solar demand (no surplus charge), with slow fueled driving (engine charge), after engine stop, after save/reload and on a remote client.
